entry_points.text: Converge missing, file, swap, marker, userfault and NUMA faults; own locking, stability and install with fallback or retry plus wait and migration; need snapshot stability, resolve async userfault in kernel, skip absent or device NUMA folios.

exports.text: Install and clear leaf mappings with area protections, youth, reverse-map and reclaim membership and cache coherence; clear invalidates only when prior entry was accessible and returns it.
Resolve swap or marker entries, obtain or migrate storage, install present mappings with major/minor accounting, copy merged pages privately when needed, report poison.
Decide leaf writability by sharing attribute, report dirty-tracking need for shared writable areas from notify or writeback support, identify secret memory by operations-vector equality.
Observe leaf or middle entries under the level lock and sleep only while migration persists, otherwise release and return promptly.
Translate a normal mapped page to its folio with null on absence, find the area covering or following an address, expose iterator current area assuming caller locks.

hazards.text: Handle poison with unmap and possible retry, warn and zero-fill bad user sources, bus-error unsupported cases, exhaust on alloc shortage, retry on races and concurrent invalidation; terminate empty, unknown and guard markers; warn on bad flags and counts.

Signal VM_FAULT_OOM, VM_FAULT_SIGBUS, VM_FAULT_NOPAGE, VM_FAULT_RETRY, VM_FAULT_LOCKED, VM_FAULT_COMPLETED, VM_FAULT_HWPOISON, VM_FAULT_DONE_COW and major/minor with VM_FAULT_ERROR family marker; distinguish poison, guard and userfault marker categories.

Take FAULT_FLAG_WRITE, FAULT_FLAG_MKWRITE, FAULT_FLAG_VMA_LOCK, FAULT_FLAG_ORIG_PTE_VALID with VM_SHARED, VM_WRITE and anon, copy and userfault marks; derive protections from area config with zero-backing respecting policy.

invariants.text: Use zeroed movable folios with charge and throttle, pick largest feasible anon order when monitoring disarmed with suitable empty aligned range, narrow swap-in orders by policy and contiguity, round swap origin, account residency.

Reuse anon only with sole ownership, no merging and stable counts, no FOLIO_MM_IDS_SHARED_BITNUM for large; map merged swap directly only when allowed else fresh copy; exclusive spans assume single refs; swap-cache release needs membership plus sync, full, locked or write-exclusive.

File faults check stability, copy for non-shared writes, respect size with fallback, prefer middle then leaf, surround only with bulk clamped window; swap pins device, prefers cache, needs contiguity, inherits protections preserving marks with traps.

Upgrade writability only with area write and no tracking demand; private needs exclusive anon, shared needs dirty; select by sharing; allow write pins unless tracking needed; reject device, frame and secret areas for direct access; validate direction flags.

Restore defaults with youth and caller writability within folio, table and area overlap, skip foreign or unsuitable entries preserving traps; lookup never grows stacks; disarmed markers clear to empty, armed take missing path.

Helpers for refcounts, throttling, swap, cache, bits, errors, stability, user copy, dirty balance, locks, dax, time, anon marks, perf, NUMA and swap accounting are owned elsewhere and used only by interface.

locks.text: Touch leaves only under the table lock; after any unlock reacquire and compare to snapshot, refresh caches and abandon on mismatch with single abort and multi retry, same for emulation, copy retry, marker clear and protection faults.

Hold folio exclusivity across dirty and transfer, revalidate swap identity under table lock, hold extra ref across hooks, bracket exclusive restore with invalidation; throttle may drop address-space lock; drop area lock with retry before hooks without bulk support.

Run bulk mapping under read protection with leaf prealloc when middle empty; restore with start/commit pairing and cache update; hold level lock for migration waits, sleeping only while migration persists.

state_machines.text: Split anon from file with locked recheck; reads try surround then fetch; anon serves zero reads and allocates private, verifying empty and stable before publish; private file writes copy and finalize, shared writes notify then dirty.
Split shared writes into frame and page paths; both drop the lock for hooks when permitted then reacquire and finalize, page path holding extra ref and dirtying after; no hook reuses current mapping.

Prioritize poison for markers: poison, guard, unknown and empty terminate, migration waits, exclusive restores, device migrates, generic delegates, userfault dissolves when disarmed else missing path.

Skip retry-awaiting faults in accounting, count failures, stop before task and perf on errors, mark major when flagged or retried else minor; recency either saves area in task state or tracks nothing.

structs.text: Fault context carries area as vma with address, middle as pmd and leaf as pte with ptl, current and saved entries with orig_pte, flags, optional page and prealloc_pte, reused across checks with slot cleared or revalidated.
